description: How Excel stores a reference whose column letters spell a function (T, N, PI) or a LET or LAMBDA parameter, and whether it reads this library's write of the same formulas. Formulas were given to Excel through Range.Formula2 in a fresh workbook, then saved and the stored <f> text read out of the package. Excel stores every such reference as typed: a column with a $ on either side, and the far end of a whole-column range, takes neither _xleta. nor _xlpm. A bare T:T inside LET(T,...) is the exception, where Excel reads both ends as the parameter and stores _xlpm.T:_xlpm.T.
probe: one-off COM script (Workbooks.Add, Range.Value2, Range.Formula2, SaveAs as .xlsx); tools/excel-oracle/run.ts --xlsx --no-resave on this library's package and on the package written before the fix
openClass: headless COM (DisplayAlerts off) for the save; run.ts opens read-only

writtenByThisLibrary.what: the fixture's values and typed formulas authored through the model, written with fullCalcOnLoad

writtenBeforeTheFix.what: the same model written by the library as it was at 3.2.0, which stored $_xleta.T$1, T:_xleta.T, $_xlpm.T$1 and the like
writtenBeforeTheFix.error: Unable to get the Open property of the Workbooks class
